Bonifacio Monument.fact: The monument, 13.7 meters (45 ft) in height, contains symbolic images and other features called the "Cry of Balintawak".

Bonifacio Monument.subject: International Relations
Bonifacio Monument.question: The cornerstone was formally laid by Aurora Quezon, the wife of _____ and future President Manuel L. Quezon, on November 30, 1929, Bonifacio's 66th birth anniversary
Bonifacio Monument.fact: The cornerstone was formally laid by Aurora Quezon, the wife of Filipino Senate President and future President Manuel L. Quezon, on November 30, 1929, Bonifacio's 66th birth anniversary.

Bonifacio Monument.subject: International Relations
Bonifacio Monument.question: The monument, which was created under the orders of American Governor-_____, was inaugurated exactly four years later on November 30, 1933
Bonifacio Monument.fact: The monument, which was created under the orders of American Governor-General Frank Murphy, was inaugurated exactly four years later on November 30, 1933.
